items.title: Vanishing and comparison statements for the cohomology of a pullback of a uniformly annihilated module
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file local-cohomology.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The counted statement collects five case-by-case vanishing and comparison assertions for the cohomology of the pullback of a uniformly annihilated module (author lemma at source lines 5144-5171, label lemma-vanishing-coh-almost-projective). The proof (source lines 5173-5290) resolves the module by a finite free module over the quotient, keeping the uniform type of the kernel, and then treats the five cases in turn: vanishing in the top two degrees, the vanishing of the comparison map in intermediate degrees, and the two forms of the statement for degree zero, the last of which is reduced to the same computation as the intermediate case (proof lines 5284-5290). The resolution and the case analysis are the content. H2.
